''See also: [[Sage Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Sages]] represent a peak stage of [[advancement]] for [[sacred artists]], positioned above [[Archlord|Archlords]]. They achieve this status by connecting with an [[Icon]], which is a symbolic representation of a greater concept or reality. This connection requires intense [[willpower]] training and conceptual alignment with the [[Icon]]'s meaning. Unlike [[Heralds]], who focus their power inwardly to enhance themselves, [[Sages]] focus their [[willpower]] externally to directly influence and change the world through their [[Authority|authority]]. While they possess immense power, they are considered more vulnerable than [[Heralds]] in physical combat; however, they compensate for this through unique abilities tied to their [[Icons]]. [[Sages]] are characterized by several distinct traits. They are often perceived as having an old or weary mentality, even if they appear young. Traditionally, [[Sages]] do not take true disciples because they are reluctant to pass on their specific [[Paths]] or because training others can result in weak imitations of themselves. Various notable [[Sages]] exist, including the [[Sword Sage]] (also known as [[Timaias Adama|Adama]] or the [[Sage of the Endless Sword]]), the [[Sage of Red Faith]], the [[Sage of a Thousand Eyes]], the [[Winter Sage]], and the [[Void Sage]]. Their influence is widespread, with their reputations often becoming legendary across continents.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|In the [[Sacred Valley]], the title of Sage is surrounded by vague legends, though the true nature of their power remains a secret to anyone below the rank of [[Archlord]]. To achieve this status, an individual must contact an [[Icon]], which grants them [[Authority|authority]] to command reality directly within a specific scope. While the concept of a Sage was historically more fluid, modern [[Sages]] possess the capability to ferry people across vast distances. Following the [[Uncrowned]] competition, a month of specialized training is required, though even powerful individuals like [[Dross]] struggle to comprehend the full extent of these abilities.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">12</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|After the [[Uncrowned]] competition, there is a month of [[Sage]] training.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5">''Wintersteel'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Dross]] cannot yet comprehend the nature of [[Sage]] powers.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6">''Wintersteel'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Sages]] are capable of ferrying people across great distances.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7">''Wintersteel'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|A Sage represents a specific destination or state of [[advancement]] that an individual can reach. This rank is held by the founder of the [[Sect of Twin Stars]] and was once possessed by the owner of a [[white badge]]. While [[Lindon]] eventually attains this status, he is initially addressed as a young Sage by [[Subject One]]. At this level of power, individuals can utilize techniques capable of blotting out [[spiritual perception]]. Furthermore, [[Sages]] and [[Heralds]] are required to swear an oath when they make progress in their [[advancement]] or approach the truth. It is believed that only those at the Sage or [[Herald]] level possess the ability to survive and alter the workings of [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Lindon]] holds the status of a [[Sage]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c6">''Reaper'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|No one below [[Sage]] or [[Herald]] is believed to have the ability to survive and alter [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]]'s workings.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c9">''Reaper'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The owner of the [[white badge]] was a [[Sage]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c11">''Reaper'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Sages]] can send out techniques that blot out [[spiritual perception]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c19">''Reaper'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Subject One]] addressed [[Lindon]] as a young [[Sage]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c22">''Reaper'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Sages]] and [[Heralds]] are made to swear an oath when they come close to the truth or make progress in [[advancement]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c25">''Reaper'', chapter 25</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Sage]] is a destination or state one can reach.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c26">''Reaper'', chapter 26</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|After [[Lindon]] instructed [[Kahn Mala]] to address him as Sage, the title was identified as a potential rank or path for [[Mercy]]. While [[Sages]] possess [[Authority|authority]] bound within their techniques similar to [[Monarchs]], their bodies lack the ability to conduct [[willpower]] in the same manner as a [[Herald]]. During an excursion into [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], a Sage called out [[Lindon]]'s name, and it was noted that [[Orthos]] and [[Little Blue]] functioned as a new Sage and [[Herald]] pair. Although the energy within a specific page might provide guidance toward achieving this stage, a blonde Sage with gray streaks in her hair eventually entered the [[vault]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Sage]] is a potential path or rank for [[Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Sages]] and [[Monarchs]] have [[Authority|authority]] bound up in their techniques.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c8">''Waybound'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A [[Sage]] called [[Lindon]]'s name from within [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c15">''Waybound'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Sage]] bodies cannot conduct [[willpower]] like a [[Herald]]'s can.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c17">''Waybound'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Orthos]] and [[Little Blue]] were a new [[Sage]] and [[Herald]] respectively.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19">''Waybound'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“Six fights left,” Mercy said. “Six days. After that, the Uncrowned will be taken away for a month of Sage training.”<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“You seeing if you can beat me to Sage?” Yerin asked.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c20" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|“Last chance? You think they’ll haul you back from spending time with the youngest Sage and some kind of tiny Herald?<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c5" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|“The Sage brought this to our lands,” Elder Whisper continued, “a tool granted to him by a Monarch. A key to the prison at the depths of the labyrinth.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c22" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|“I can’t see anyone below Sage or Herald having the ability to both survive and alter its workings,” Eithan said.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c9" />}}
